test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

For years he pursued a __vendetta__ against the Morris family.
solution: The correct answer is "**harmony**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Vendetta"** means a prolonged bitter feud or rivalry. (दो व्‍यक्तियों या परिवारों आदि के बीच लंबा विवाद या कलह, ख़ानदानी झगड़ा; कुल वैर) • **Example:** *He saw himself as the victim of a personal **vendetta**__ being waged by his political enemies.* • **"Harmony"** means a state of peaceful coexistence or agreement. (सामंजस्‍य, तालमेल) __ • **Example:** *We need to live more in **harmony**__ with our environment.* • The antonym of **"vendetta"** is **"harmony."** • So, the correct answer is** Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **"Conflict"** means a serious disagreement or argument. ((किसी बात पर) झगड़ा, संघर्ष या विवाद) • **"Traduce"** means to speak badly or tell lies about someone. (किसी के बारे में बुरा बोलना या झूठ बोलना) • **"Tirade"** means a long, angry speech. (लंबा, क्रोधपूर्ण, निंदात्मक भाषण) 38:T5b8, Here, the erroneous part is **'Even if a evidence was'.**
